written.headline: Chinese labs DeepSeek and Moonshot AI used OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra for model distillation
written.summary: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and Moonshot AI used outputs from OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra to train their latest models, DeepSeek’s V4.1‑Flash‑1017 and Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3.1 Pro. The practice, known as distillation, has raised concerns about US‑China AI competition and model‑copying safeguards.
